termsDocRef: Document Reference: SAH-TC-2025-V2.0 | Governing Law: Arab Republic of Egypt
termsIntroOwner: By listing a property on the Sahely platform, you irrevocably agree to the following terms and the Platform Master Rules.
termsIntroRenter: By completing a booking on the Sahely platform, you irrevocably agree to the following terms and the Platform Master Rules.
termsIntroBroker: By registering as a Broker, you irrevocably agree to the following terms and the Platform Master Rules.
termsAgreeFootnote: By clicking "I Agree", you irrevocably accept all {role} Terms and Platform Master Rules outlined above.
termsOwnerSection1Point1: Minimum listing period is one (1) full calendar month per season.
termsOwnerSection1Point2: You may declare up to five (5) personal-use blackout days per month in advance via the app.
termsOwnerSection1Point3: Withdrawing a listed property or canceling a confirmed booking constitutes a chargeable violation.
termsOwnerSection2Point1: The platform provides one (1) smart lock free of charge. It remains platform property.
termsOwnerSection2Point2: You must install and activate it within three (3) calendar days of signing the agreement. Failure incurs a flat charge of EGP 500.
termsOwnerSection2Point3: You may not access the property during an active rental without providing 24 hours prior notice via the app (emergency access is logged and reviewed).
termsOwnerSection2Point4: You are solely responsible for maintaining operational internet connectivity for the lock.
termsOwnerSection3Point1: You must collect the Renter’s valid national ID and complete the police security check to obtain compound QR/beach access codes.
termsOwnerSection3Point2: Deadline: Prior to check-in for daytime bookings, or by 12:00 PM the following day for bookings confirmed after 6:00 PM. Late completion results in a 5% deduction from your payout.
termsOwnerSection3Point3: Professional cleaning is mandatory between every checkout and check-in (minimum 4-hour gap). Failure results in a 10% deduction and platform cleaning at your expense.
termsOwnerSection3Point4: The property must exactly match its listing photos. Material mismatch results in a 20% deduction and a full refund to the Renter at your expense.
termsOwnerSection4Point1: Platform commission is 15%, automatically deducted. Payouts are released within 48 hours of confirmed Renter check-in.
termsOwnerSection4Point2: Pre-Listing & Pre-Arrival Checklists: Must be completed in the app before the Renter’s access code is released.
termsOwnerSection4Point3: Post-Rental Checklist: Must be submitted within 24 hours of checkout with photographic evidence of any damage. Failure to submit within 24 hours results in permanent forfeiture of your right to claim against the Renter’s security deposit.
termsOwnerSection4Point4: Removal Policy: Three (3) platform or compound violations attributable to your negligence within a single season will result in permanent removal from Sahely.
termsRenterSection1Point1: Full payment and a security deposit (equivalent to one night’s rate) are required to confirm any booking.
termsRenterSection1Point2: Grace Period: Full refund if canceled within 1 hour of booking.
termsRenterSection1Point3: Advance Bookings (7+ days before check-in): 80% refund if canceled 7+ days prior; 50% refund if 3–6 days prior; No refund if fewer than 3 days prior.
termsRenterSection1Point4: Last-Minute Bookings (<7 days before check-in): No refund after the 1-hour grace period.
termsRenterSection1Point5: Same-Day/No-Shows: No cancellation permitted; no refund issued.
termsRenterSection1Point6: MAWSEM Token: Level 6 users may use one Free Cancellation Token for a full refund if canceled ≥48 hours before check-in.
termsRenterSection2Point1: A valid Egyptian National ID or passport is mandatory for police security checks. Fraudulent IDs result in immediate booking cancellation, forfeiture of payments, and a permanent ban.
termsRenterSection2Point2: Property access is granted solely via a unique app passcode, active only during the booked period. Sharing the code or exceeding maximum occupancy is a strict violation.
termsRenterSection2Point3: No gatherings/events exceeding max occupancy. Smoking is prohibited unless explicitly stated. Late checkout incurs a charge of one additional night’s rate.
termsRenterSection3Point1: The property is inspected within 24 hours of checkout. Deposits are refunded within 48 hours if no damage is found.
termsRenterSection3Point2: You are financially liable for any damage exceeding the security deposit amount.
termsRenterSection3Point3: You are solely responsible for any compound violations. Charges levied by the compound will be deducted immediately from your deposit with no dispute window.
termsRenterSection4Point1: Upon check-in, you must complete the Arrival Checklist in the app within a strict two (2) hour window.
termsRenterSection4Point2: You must upload photographic evidence for any "Issue Found".
termsRenterSection4Point3: Crucial: Failure to report an issue within this 2-hour window constitutes your unconditional acceptance that the property was received in perfect condition.
termsBrokerSection1Point1: You must be at least 18 years old with a valid Egyptian ID/Passport, verified phone number, and email. Multiple accounts per individual are strictly prohibited.
termsBrokerSection1Point2: You will receive one (1) unique, non-transferable referral link. Attribution is automatic and tamper-proof.
termsBrokerSection2Point1: A thirty (30) calendar day earning window commences when a property attributed to your link goes live.
termsBrokerSection2Point2: You earn a commission on every completed rental during this window. The window expires automatically at 23:59 on the 30th day.
termsBrokerSection2Point3: If a booking is canceled and a non-refunded amount is retained, you earn your tier commission on that non-refunded amount.
termsBrokerSection4Point1: Commissions are credited within 48 hours of the Renter’s confirmed check-in. Minimum cash-out is EGP 200.
termsBrokerSection4Point2: Strict Cap: The total referral and commission payout on any single booking is capped at 5% of the gross booking value.
termsBrokerSection5Point1: You may not solicit false/uninspected properties, share your link for third-party attribution, or accept side payments from Owners.
termsBrokerSection5Point2: Violations result in immediate permanent removal, forfeiture of commissions, and potential legal action.
termsMasterRulesPoint1: The platform holds final, binding, and non-appealable authority over all disputes within the season.
termsMasterRulesPoint2: Direct financial transactions or off-platform rentals are strictly prohibited and will result in immediate permanent removal.
termsMasterRulesPoint3: All disputes must be submitted via the app within 24 hours of the incident. App logs are primary legal evidence.
termsMasterRulesPoint4: These terms are governed exclusively by the laws of the Arab Republic of Egypt.
